emails.subject: URGENT: SAE Report - Study DNLI-123 - Site 456 - Patient 456-007
emails.body:
Hi Jane,

This is an urgent notification of a Serious Adverse Event for a patient in study DNLI-123.

Patient ID: 456-007
Site: 456 (Sun Valley Medical Center)
Cohort: Part B (FTD)
Event: Hospitalization for a severe seizure. The event occurred last night, and the patient was admitted to the hospital early this morning.

We are currently gathering all necessary information and completing the SAE form. We will send it to you as soon as possible.

Please let us know of any immediate actions required.

Best regards,

Dr. Helena Ramirez
Principal Investigator
Sun Valley Medical Center

emails.subject: Re: URGENT: SAE Report - Study DNLI-123 - Site 456 - Patient 456-007
emails.body:
Hi Dr. Ramirez,

Thank you for the urgent notification. I have received it and will notify the internal safety team immediately.

Please send the completed SAE form and all relevant de-identified source documents (e.g., ER report, admission notes, relevant lab results) as soon as they are available, and no later than 24 hours from your awareness of the event.

I will be available should you have any questions.

Best regards,

Jane Doe
Clinical Research Associate
Denali Therapeutics

emails.subject: URGENT NOTIFICATION: New SAE - Study DNLI-123 - Site 456 - Hospitalization for Seizure
emails.body:
Denali Safety and Medical Team,

This is an initial notification of a new SAE at Site 456 (Sun Valley Medical Center).

Patient 456-007, enrolled in the Part B FTD cohort, has been hospitalized for a severe seizure. 

I have been in contact with the site PI, Dr. Ramirez, and have requested the completed SAE form and relevant source documents. I will forward these materials as soon as I receive them, which is expected within the 24-hour reporting window.

Please let me know of any immediate actions required from my side.

Best,

Jane Doe
Clinical Research Associate
Denali Therapeutics

description: An urgent email thread from the Principal Investigator at a participating site reporting a Serious Adverse Event (SAE). A patient in Part B (FTD cohort) has been hospitalized for a severe seizure.
